**Answer**

The regulatory liability that Entergy Corporation recorded in October 2015 as a result of the Entergy Gulf States Louisiana and Entergy Louisiana business combination was **$1,000 million**.  
The tax liability associated with the same event was **$100 million**.

**Ratio**

\[
\text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Regulatory liability}}{\text{Tax liability}}
              = \frac{1{,}000\ \text{million}}{100\ \text{million}}
              = 10
\]

**Final value:** **10 : 1** (regulatory liability is ten times the tax liability).
